retrievalProfile.description: A dark, moody composition featuring a vertically mirrored or stacked motion-blurred portrait in deep red tones against a pure black void.
triggerTerms: long exposure face blur black background
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical column of glowing, deep-red motion-blurred human forms, appearing as two stacked or mirrored faces, emerging from an absolute black environment with high-contrast serif typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the upper and lower blurred forms
Extreme contrast between the saturated red subject and the void-like black background
Tension between the fluid, organic blur and the sharp, structured typography
coreInvariants: Horizontal motion blur streaks within the red forms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically, occupying the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightest point of the lower red blur acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves vertically from the top blur down to the bottom blur, finally resting on the white text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the central column, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background providing depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep crimson and blood red for the subject matter.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds with very low value (darkness), contrasted by the high value of the white text.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Open counters in circular letters like 'O' and 'C'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial letters for primary title
Tight kerning to create a unified block

composition.relationshipToImage: Anchors the composition at the base

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale-based hierarchy using the same serif family in different sizes.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment bar implied by text baseline

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant sharp serifs.
Extreme stroke contrast matches the dramatic lighting.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical composition with a pure black background. In the center, place two vertically stacked, abstract human faces rendered with heavy horizontal motion blur in deep red and orange tones. The forms should look like long-exposure light paintings, glowing from within the darkness.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered typographic lockup at the bottom using a high-contrast white serif font. The main title should be large and uppercase, with a smaller subtitle or artist name centered directly beneath it.

verificationChecks: Are the red forms sufficiently blurred to be abstract?
Is the text perfectly centered at the bottom?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Vertical spacing between the two blurred forms
Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Avoid any recognizable facial features; keep it abstract
Do not use any colors other than red, orange, black, and white

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of red light into black void
Sharp, legible typography despite the dark theme
avoid: Visible grain or noise in the black areas
Muddy or brown tones in the red blur

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black #000000 at the edges
Verify the motion blur is strictly horizontal
Confirm the text is not touching the red subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark Void + Mirrored Motion Blur [Red] + High-Contrast Serif [White, Bottom-Centered]
